children: Hungary should not delay entry into the Exchange Rate Mechanism (ERM-2), the waiting room of the euro, if the market finds the government's euro adoption road map to be presented later this month credible, central bank Deputy Governor Zoltan Kurali said.

If fiscal and monetary policy consistently aim for euro adoption, market expectations will set the equilibrium exchange rate level for entry, Kurali also told a conference organised by financial news website portfolio.hu on Tuesday.
